test_title: PYST 62: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, E, I, O, U, S and K are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). K is to the immediate right of O. E is the immediate neighbour of both O and S. I is neither an immediate neighbour of S nor A. Who is to the immediate right of U?
solution:
A, E, I, O, U, S and K are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

(1) K is to the immediate right of O.

(2) E is the immediate neighbour of both O and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0833602447f573567d16423dc59ded4fa73b2482ab8a298f34d10d4d22918bbe.png] 

(3) I is neither an immediate neighbour of S nor A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3febc1e12dd61dc6ee09115dd515786cde57d1d6da9b798c11bd2fcc81a33fa1.png] 

According to the final arrangement, **A is immediate right of U**.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (2)**".
